G2 Checkpoint Purpose: This checkpoint prepares the cell for division. Check: The cell checks if DNA replication was successful and if it has enough resources to support division. Decision: If everything looks good, the cell gets the green light to enter the final stage (M phase). If there are issues, the cell might pause for repairs or enter a resting state.
